main_body: Flat grass ground patch, 4x3 tiles, olive green with sparse light and dark tufts, no standing volume
top_band: none - terrain tile, no standing object; uniform grass surface
evidence: The candidate is a ground terrain patch (grass) that tiles seamlessly. It has no standing volume, so the top/front contract does not apply. No side faces, no elevation drawing. Terrain kind matches the grass ground surface.

style.evidence: The candidate is a mostly flat mid-olive green base with sparse tufts of one lighter and one darker green, repeated in an identical pattern every tile. Only about 3 lightness steps (base, light tuft, dark tuft). The base colour fills large areas with no grain or variation, so it is a flat fill. The Beodeul grass reference has several greens, clumped tufts and varied dark patches, giving richer tiles. Each candidate tile carries roughly 3-4 colours against the reference's higher count. The repeating tufts also look stamped rather than hand-shaded.
